On June 10, 2020, Automatic Data Processing, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the “Company”), entered into a $3.225 billion 364-Day Credit Agreement (the “364-Day Facility”) with a group of lenders. The 364-Day Facility replaced the Company’s prior $3.80 billion 364-day facility, entered into on June 12, 2019, which was terminated on June 10, 2020.
